# FieldAttribute

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · attribute

```csharp
public sealed class FieldAttribute : Attribute
```

Declares a parameter of the component classes it is put on.

## Constructors

```csharp
public FieldAttribute(string name, FieldKind kind)
```

Declares a field.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | Name used in YAML: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, for example `drive`. `type`, `user` and `continue_on_error` are reserved. |
| `kind` | The type of the value. |

## Properties

### Default

```csharp
public string? Default { get; set; }
```

The value used when the automation does not set it, written as in YAML (for example `"30s"` or `"true"`).

On a trigger, a field with a default always filters events; leave filters without a default.

```csharp
public string Description { get; set; }
```

What the field means, in plain English. Required.

### KeyField

```csharp
public bool KeyField { get; set; }
```

For revertible actions: this field tells settings apart (for example the drive letter), so two actions with different values change different settings.

### Placeholders

```csharp

```

For text fields: whether `{{ placeholders }}` are replaced before the action gets the value. True by default; set it to false for fields that are interpreted as code or commands.
